# livekit_webhook (Resource)

A webhook: a URL a LiveKit Cloud project sends its room, participant, track, egress and ingress events to, signed with the secret of one of the project's API keys. Every change is made in place. The API accepts several webhooks with the same URL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "livekit_api_key" "webhooks" {
  description = "webhook signing"
}

resource "livekit_webhook" "backend" {
  name           = "backend"
  url            = "https://api.example.com/livekit/webhook"
  signing_key    = livekit_api_key.webhooks.id
  include_events = ["room_started", "room_finished", "participant_joined", "participant_left"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS URL the events are POSTed to. The API refuses a URL that does not resolve to a public address.

### Optional

- `exclude_events` (Set of String) Deliver every event but these. Names come from `data.livekit_webhook_events`; the API refuses others.
- `include_events` (Set of String) Deliver only these events. With neither `include_events` nor `exclude_events`, the webhook gets every event. Names come from `data.livekit_webhook_events`; the API refuses others.
- `name` (String) A label for the webhook. Defaults to `""`.
- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`) the webhook belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the webhook is created; a later change of that default does not move it. Changing this argument replaces the webhook.
- `signing_key` (String) ID (`API...`) of the project's API key whose secret signs the deliveries; a key ID, not a secret. When not set, the API picks the project's oldest key when the webhook is created, and removing the argument later keeps the key. The webhook keeps the ID even when that key is deleted, and then cannot be verified: delete keys with care.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a webhook by "<project_id>/<webhook_id>".
terraform import livekit_webhook.backend p_abc123/j9g9wQx3RbmZNw28qgRWsR
```
